title: Xavier and Sadie Herbert's Cottage
representedDate: Standing cottage represented as described in the Queensland Heritage Register after the Herbert-era alterations.
geometryBasis: The state heritage parcel bounds the cottage beside the Red Beret Hotel and opposite the station. The road-facing polygon edge supplies frontage and orientation. The written cottage profile guides subdivision of the longer mapped roof.
sectionBasis: The Queensland Heritage Register records a single-storey low-stump cottage, enclosed front and rear verandahs, corrugated hipped roof, aluminium weatherboard-like cladding, front lattice, east skillion garage and concrete block rear addition.
limitations: The land parcel, front building width and orientation derive from native mapping. The original cottage roof overlaps a long mapped outline. The residential and rear service bounds interpreted from the heritage text, cladding colors and exact dimensions are approximate.
The model includes the main cottage, attached verandahs, adjacent carport and rear block room. The separate guest garage, precinct buildings and demolished writer’s shed are outside this structure.
